about: A Ruby library for reading and editing Word documents.

prs.title: Edits to Word for the web files are saved
prs.broken: Documents saved by Word for the web keep their text in a differently named part, so every edit was silently lost on save.
prs.changed: The library now remembers which part it read and writes the changes back to it.
prs.matters: Filled-in templates and edits actually end up in the saved file.

prs.title: Text that looks like HTML stays text when a document is shown as HTML
prs.broken: Turning a document into HTML copied its text and link addresses in as they were, so anything that looked like a tag vanished or became real markup in the page.
prs.changed: Text and attribute values are now escaped before they go into the HTML.
prs.matters: Documents show up in a browser exactly as written, and markup inside a document can't sneak into the page.
